final: SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy' ORDER BY a.attribute_name    -- Aquababy's attributes: Intelligence (60), Strength (20), Speed (15), Durability (15), Power (15), Combat (15)
